errors.text: The proposed intervention adds an unspecified amount of Cr to a coating that already contains Cr, so the compositional change is not operationally defined.
The claimed BCC and Laves-phase mechanism is transferred from WVTaTiCr coatings on steel and is not established for FCC FeNiCrCoCu on Cu.
The experiment provides no rejection criterion for the proposed grain-refinement, phase-precipitation, or oxidation-resistance mechanism, despite explicitly requiring mechanistic falsification.
The oxidation-based rationale may be irrelevant to the hidden target's nonoxidizing atomistic indentation/sliding simulations.
